dedupe_keys.name: seenergies open data hub heat demand district heating areas excess heat and energy efficiency potentials for europe

description: The sEEnergies Open Data hub is an ArcGIS Hub that publishes the spatial outputs of the sEEnergies project on energy efficiency and heat in Europe. On the day of cataloguing its search API listed 53 items, including heat demand density image collections for 2015, 2030 and 2050 baseline and scenario cases, Pan-European Thermal Atlas heat demand layers, district heating areas, future district heating potentials, urban area heat demands and heat sources, industry sites with demand and best available technology data, excess heat contours, available excess heat from wastewater treatment plants, urban time series, electric road route scenarios and CSV tables of transport and industry efficiency potentials to 2050. The district heating areas item, for example, was built by Halmstad University from Heat Roadmap Europe 4 heat demand densities of 500 GJ per hectare and above, combined with OpenStreetMap place names and current systems from the Halmstad University district heating and cooling database, and was modified on 18 March 2025. Items are available as free feature services, image collections and CSV downloads; the item read is licensed CC BY 4.0. Coverage is Europe. Caveats: licences and methods are set per item and documented in project deliverable reports, and the project has ended. Simulation uses are heat demand and district heating potential maps for European heat planning and energy system models. Related records: data-hotmaps-electricity-district-heating-scenarios is a related heat planning source.
